as_told.title: FOIA request on Project Preserve Destiny forwarded from Air Force to NSA

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of an independent researcher named Noah Rodek who used FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records, to ask the Air Force about Project Preserve Destiny. That is a secret programme described by Dan Sherman, a former Air Force man, in his book Above Black. According to Michels, the Air Force passed the request on to the NSA, the US spy agency that handles communications intelligence, which he takes as a sign that the project may be real and tied to that agency.
